# Root Cause workflow telemetry
Inspect per-goal latency, model token usage and fallbacks. Sensitive evidence/prompt content is not recorded.

content.query: dependencies | where name == 'goal.workflow' | summarize mean_ms=avg(duration / 1ms), p95_ms=percentile(duration / 1ms, 95), goals=count() by bin(timestamp, 5m)
content.title: Goal workflow latency

content.query: traces | where message has_any ('fallback', 'failed', 'unavailable') | project timestamp, message, operation_Id | order by timestamp desc
content.title: Failures and fallback diagnostics
